references.text: Balaam tells Balak to stand by the burnt offering while he goes to meet the Lord; this same pattern is repeated.
Balak had just sacrificed oxen and sheep, and Balaam now stands by these offerings.
God meets Balaam as he expected when he went away.
Later, Balaam stopped seeking omens and did not go away as he did here.
Abraham tells the group to wait while he goes away to worship; a similar situation where some are left by the offering.
Samuel tells Saul to wait by the burnt offering until he returns; the same concept of waiting by the offering.
